title: Discrete Zero-Pole (with initial outputs)
text: Discrete Zero-Pole (with initial outputs), {Gain} sets Gain value; {Zeros} sets the matrix of zeros, {Poles} sets the vector of poles, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the interval between samples, {State name} sets the unique name for block and {State name must resolve to Simulink signal object} requires state name resolve to a signal. Values come from the instance.

params.name: State name
params.values: Unique name for block state '''''''' (default) | alphanumeric string

params.name: State name must resolve to Simulink signal object
params.values: Require state name resolve to a signal object off (default) | on
